review.intent: An isolated, editable exterior study of the arena, including its visible plinth, glazed concourse, tiered titanium skin and offset crown.
review.viewpoint: Fixed elevated oblique view after Archasia R-12. All geometry and cell boundaries use the same photographic projection. The XY grid is the already projected picture plane.
sources: Archasia 1.3.2R-12.webp: main silhouette, warm left-hand reflection, entrance ribbons, glazing and cladding.
Archasia 1.3.2T-02.webp: stepped offset crown, roof-field divisions and front signage.
Populous: approximately 270 × 170 m plan; Taipei City tourism: 74.5 m ground to roof.
assumptions: 100 pixels/metre before foreshortening. Approximate 33-degree plan rotation gives a 245 m projected span; 38 drawing pixels per reference-preview pixel. Secondary member sizes inferred from photographs, not survey data.

partitionLimitation.message: Automatic partitions require independent projected faces, surface grids or patterns; preserve unsupported child relationships.
